name: Killinardish House
address: Killinardish House, Knockroe, Drangan, Co. Tipperary
questions: The house is on Tipperary's Record of Protected Structures (TRPS1581, 'Killinardish, Knockroe, Drangan'). Does the protection extend to the convent wing, the schoolhouse and the girls' school as curtilage, is there a Section 57 declaration, and did the 2018 works (external insulation, new windows, PVC French doors) have the council's consent?
Can you send a site map with the boundaries and the site area? Is the rear lawn and schoolyard walled or fenced all round (we have two dogs), and who owns the wall along the side road?

Is there a survey or a quote for the convent wing's roof and the water ingress, how long has it been leaking, and has any damp reached the main house? When was the main roof last inspected beyond the 2019 valley repairs?

Is the house on mains water and the public sewer, what broadband is connected (provider and speed), and has the property or the road outside ever flooded? BuyerIQ shows a mapped flood zone about 300 m away.
Is there a floor plan? Is the shower room next to the Bedroom/Family Room, and could a ground-floor bedroom work without losing the only other reception room?

ai.why: A restored former convent with real character, four bathrooms and B3; the wing repairs (a rough €20–60k) keep it near budget. But it comes with about 530 m² of protected old buildings to maintain, a crossroads setting, a ground-floor bedroom that uses up a reception room, and no train within 35 minutes.

electricity.detail: Connected; rewired in 2018, with a 10.5 kVA automatic backup generator that starts in a power cut.

water.detail: Likely mains; not stated, but the house is in the centre of Drangan village. New plumbing went in in 2018. Confirm with the agent.

sewer.detail: Unknown; not stated. A village-centre house may be on the public sewer or on its own septic tank. Ask.

internet.detail: Unknown; the listing doesn't mention broadband and BuyerIQ shows 'no data' for this Eircode. NBI's neighbouring Mullinahone/Ballingarry/Cloneen deployment was due to finish in early 2024, and the village may be in eir's own rural fibre area instead, so fibre is plausible but unconfirmed. Check nbi.ie and eir by Eircode.
internet.speed: up to 500 Mb–1 Gb if connected (unconfirmed)

groundFloorBedroom.detail: The listing offers the 5.0 × 4.8 m 'Bedroom/Family Room' (stove, shutters, French doors to the side), now a sitting room, as a ground-floor bedroom, with a 2.3 × 1.7 m shower room (electric shower) on the same floor; there is no floor plan, and using it leaves the 6.6 × 5.0 m living/dining room as the only reception.

type: Detached two-storey former convent house (protected structure), with a disconnected convent wing and two former school buildings
bedsNote: Three upstairs bedrooms, each with an en-suite (the principal with a dressing room); a 5.0 × 4.8 m ground-floor Bedroom/Family Room; the disconnected convent wing has four more small bedrooms
heating: Oil-fired central heating (listed as 'OFCH') plus two Henley solid-fuel stoves
tagline: A restored former convent house of 187 m² (BER B3) with a disconnected convent wing and two old school buildings on about 0.3 ha of walled grounds, at the crossroads in the centre of Drangan, south Tipperary.

pros.text: Period character, restored rather than stripped
pros.detail: A two-storey Georgian-style former convent: original staircase, cornices, ceiling centrepieces, working shutters and about 200-year-old doors and window frames, all kept in the 2018 refurbishment.

pros.text: Ground-floor bedroom option with a shower room
pros.detail: The 5.0 × 4.8 m Bedroom/Family Room is offered as a ground-floor bedroom, with a 2.3 × 1.7 m shower room on the same floor; three more bedrooms upstairs, each with its own bathroom.

pros.text: Room for six in 187 m², at €490k
pros.detail: Four bedrooms and four bathrooms inside the 100–280 m² brief, about €2,620/m²; stamp duty about €4,900.

pros.text: Updated in 2018: BER B3, radon barrier
pros.detail: New plumbing, wiring, insulation (including external wall insulation) and a radon barrier; BER 125.85 kWh/m²/yr (B3), oil central heating plus two stoves, and a 10.5 kVA backup generator.
Rough satellite estimate about 0.3 ha (0.6–0.85 ac): lawns front and back, a gravel yard and the old schoolyard, behind walls, railings and electric gates.

pros.text: Village primary 300 m; Clonmel ED about 25 minutes
pros.detail: St Patrick's NS Drangan (mixed) is 300 m by Daft's count; Tipperary University Hospital, Clonmel (24-hour ED that takes children) is about 20 km straight-line.

pros.text: Spare buildings for a studio or a let, with planning
pros.detail: A two-classroom schoolhouse (two rooms of about 5 × 8 m, 5 m ceilings) and an 84 m² stone girls'-school building, 'subject to planning permission and all necessary consents'.

cons.text: A protected structure with about 530 m² of old buildings
cons.detail: The house is TRPS1581 on Tipperary's Record of Protected Structures, so works need conservation consent; the 187 m² house comes with a 160 m² wing, a schoolhouse (about 90 m²) and the 84 m² girls' school, almost twice the 280 m² cap to insure, heat and maintain.

cons.text: Convent wing leaks and needs roof repairs
cons.detail: The listing says the wing's reception room needs refurbishment 'due to historic water ingress' and its landing 'requires roof repairs'; the main roof is about 35 years old (valleys repaired in 2019). Expect a rough €20–60k+ for the wing before it is usable.
The aerials show the side gable on the road edge and the front about 10 m from the street behind a wall and railings, at a junction with a stop sign; two graveyards adjoin the rear lawn.
Thurles (about 24 km straight-line, 35–40 minutes) has about 16 weekday trains to Heuston, about 1h15–1h35; Kilkenny is about 28 km.
3.6 × 3.0 m with a breakfast bar for three or four and a 2.3 × 1.0 m utility; meals for six would be in the living/dining room.
No practice was found in the village; Killenaule Surgery (HSE directory) is about 8 km, and Fethard about 9.5 km.

cons.text: Water, drainage and broadband not stated; flood zone nearby
cons.detail: The listing gives none of the three; BuyerIQ shows a moderate river flood zone about 0.3 km away and one critical finding behind its paywall.

cons.text: Under an acre, and schools unrated
cons.detail: About 0.3 ha against the 1-acre goal; the village primary has about 54 pupils (DEIS) and the nearest secondaries have no recent progression figures.
